_about_eye_rejects: Agent eye check of downloaded pool stills (2026-11-03, beat layer v10): title -> reason. Not human-reviewed.
_about_focus: Per-asset framing focus [x, y] (0-1 of the image) for stills whose subject sits off-centre; motion keeps the frame centred on it as far as the image allows (agent eye check 2026-11-03).
_about_crop_reuse: v14 crop reuse (user decision 2026-11-04 07:37: same photo may come back as a distinctly different crop, e.g. full temple then only the spire). core/crop_reuse.py. Limits: crop area <= max_area_ratio of the first framing, IoU <= max_iou with every earlier framing of that photo, >= min_beats_apart beats from every appearance, <= max_reuses_per_asset, crop >= min_crop_width px. Only continued_with_motion beats and representative beats whose narration (Hinglish words) names a place with an exact photo. extra_places = place keys used only by crop reuse (title aliases / narration aliases). rejects = '<original file>@<beat>': reason (agent eye check of out/dwarika_v14_crop_grid.jpg).
